name: Character & Token Traps
description: Letter-counting, spelling and word-manipulation tasks that LLMs famously get wrong because they see tokens, not characters. Mixed numeric / multiple-choice scoring.
system_prompt: Work character by character. End with 'Answer: <value>'.

cases.prompt: How many times does the letter 'r' appear in the word 'strawberry'?
How many times does the letter 's' appear in the word 'Mississippi'?
How many times does the letter 'e' appear in the word 'beekeeper'?
How many letters are in the word 'antidisestablishmentarianism'?
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word 'education'?
How many distinct (different) letters are used in the word 'banana'?
How many words are in this sentence: 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog'?
How many times does the two-letter sequence 'th' appear in the phrase 'the theme of this theory'?

cases.system_prompt: Answer the multiple choice question. End with 'Answer: <letter>'.
cases.prompt:
What is the 4th letter of the word 'computer'?
A) m
B) p
C) u
D) t

cases.system_prompt: Answer the multiple choice question. End with 'Answer: <letter>'.
cases.prompt:
What is the word 'WORLD' spelled backwards?
A) DRLOW
B) DLROW
C) DLORW
D) WORLD

cases.system_prompt: Answer the multiple choice question. End with 'Answer: <letter>'.
cases.prompt:
What is the last letter of the word 'reasoning'?
A) n
B) g
C) i
D) o

cases.system_prompt: Answer the multiple choice question. End with 'Answer: <letter>'.
cases.prompt:
Which of the following is an anagram of the word 'LISTEN'?
A) SILENT
B) TINSEL
C) Both SILENT and TINSEL
